title: ORCHID request timeout
text: ORCHID request timeout is 30 seconds for the request mode described by the accompanying scope note.

title: ORCHID request retry
text: ORCHID request retry permits at most three retries with exponential backoff, subject to the accompanying scope note.

title: ORCHID connection timeout
text: ORCHID connection timeout is 5 seconds. It is distinct from the request timeout.

title: ORCHID retry exclusions
text: ORCHID authentication failures must not be retried. Request timeout alone does not authorize a retry.

title: ORCHID retry eligibility
text: ORCHID request retry is permitted only for idempotent operations.

title: MAPLE unrelated service
text: MAPLE is a different fictional service. Its shelf labels describe storage locations.

title: Fictional colours
text: The fictional cabinet uses amber and violet labels. This page has no client operation rules.

title: Applicable mode and release
text: These limits apply only to unattended batch operations in release r2. Interactive operations are outside this note.
